name: Muha Meds x Cookies Disposable | Habibi
description: Habibi is a delightful strain that combines the soothing effects of a sativa with a sweet, delectable flavor profile. The aroma is reminiscent of a lush, tropical paradise with hints of fresh fruit and sugary sweetness. Perfect for unwinding after a long day, Habibi offers a relaxing and comforting experience that soothes both body and mind.
